subject.title: Group reply pipeline silently drops agent-generated payload between turn completion and Telegram sendMessage

question: Should this issue remain the broad Telegram group generated-reply/no-send tracker, or should the remaining work be folded into the message_tool_only recovery track once a canonical PR lands?
rationale: Current main has partial fixes, but the remaining behavior crosses the message_tool_only privacy contract and cannot be safely resolved by cleanup automation without maintainer direction.

options.title: Keep As Broad Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open for a current-main live Telegram group repro and use related recovery PRs only as partial overlap until they prove the group path.

options.title: Fold Into Recovery Track After Landing
options.body: After a canonical recovery PR lands, close this issue only if live or source evidence shows the group symptom is the same stranded-final class.

options.title: Reject Recovery And Document Policy
options.body: If maintainers decide message_tool_only silence is fully intentional, close this after documenting the supported automatic-mode alternative and preserving diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Keep As Broad Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a current-main live Telegram group repro and use related recovery PRs only as partial overlap until they prove the group path.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the maintainer rewrite and proof override for the current warning-only policy, making it the best available owner for the remaining delivery/privacy direction.
